text:
First attestation, written because affirm correctly refused to invent one. Read the docstring against the body at 0.63.1: it still says this reads through the same _clones_q the --json door uses, so the flag grammar cannot drift between surfaces, and that is still exactly what it does.

The logic moved because the renderer now states its own truncation - when members_shown is below members_total it prints how many were withheld and how to get them. That is not a new claim about this function, it is the function keeping the promise the docstring already implied: the payload gained members_total and members_shown, and a renderer that silently dropped them would have re-created the defect one layer up, in the surface a human actually reads.
